params.body:
Closes #1138

## What was wrong

Nightwatch #83 (production, 2026-11-26 08:47): `Intervention\Image\Exception\NotReadableException: Image source not readable` at `ImageController.php:161`, the last line of `simple_image()`. That route (`simple.index.image`) serves the vehicle category icons of the stocklist filter and extended search. It checked that the file existed on the `default` disk and then re-encoded the bytes through Intervention/GD, so any file GD could not decode (empty, truncated, a format GD lacks, not an image) was an unhandled 500.

The dealer logo and background routes lost the same fault on 2026-09-15 (`cachedImageFromDisk()`); this route was left on the old pattern.

## The change

`simple_image()` now follows the same shape as `cachedImageFromDisk()`:

- the path must be valid base64, otherwise 404;
- the file is read once with `get()` inside a try; a missing, unreadable or empty file is a 404;
- `.svg` is served as `image/svg+xml`, as before;
- anything else is served with its own bytes and the mime `finfo` finds, no GD re-encoding;
- bytes that are not `image/*` are a 404, logged as `Image not readable from disk` with disk and path, so the broken icon can be found in the log and replaced. Non-image files are still never served through this public route.

Not cached server side, unlike the logo route: an icon can be replaced under the same path. Dropping `exists()` also means the bucket is no longer asked for a directory listing on every icon (R S1-6.38).

One trade-off: a file whose header says PNG but whose body is corrupt is now served as is (the browser shows a broken icon) instead of failing. That is the same behaviour as the logo route.

## Merge order

The local branch for #1143 (signed image addresses, not yet proposed) adds `ImageSignature::guard()` as the first line of `simple_image()`. Whichever of the two lands second keeps that one line on top of the body from this PR; nothing else overlaps.

## Tests

- New `CategoryIconRouteTest`: a PNG is served with its own bytes, an SVG as SVG, a non-image is a logged 404, an empty file is a 404, a missing file is a 404, a path that is not base64 is a 404. Four of the six fail on `origin/main` (the empty file throws exactly "Image source not readable").
- `DealerLogoTest`, `SmokeTest`, `TheBucketIsNotAskedForADirectoryTest` pass.
- Full suite on a fresh test database: OK (3354 tests, 33529 assertions, 2 skipped, 1 incomplete). PHPStan: no errors.
params.title: Category icons: an unreadable icon is a logged 404, not a 500 (Nightwatch #83)
